Title: CYP2D6 metabolism
Description: Predicts both inhibition of cytochrome P450 2D6 and whether a molecule serves as its substrate. CYP2D6 is among the most strongly polymorphic drug-metabolising enzymes, and compounds cleared predominantly through it show pronounced inter-individual variability. The models come from an NCATS study that built QSAR predictors for catalysis and inhibition across CYP2C9, 2D6 and 3A4, aiming to flag isoform reliance early rather than after microsomal screening. Predictions describe enzyme interaction, not overall clearance.
Interpretation: Probability of inhibiting CYP2D6 and probability of being a substrate of the enzyme.
